verdict.rationale: Shortwave is an AI-powered email client, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions a setting, policy, or guarantee that keeps user data out of AI model training. The docs only say the AI 'learns your unique voice and style from the emails you send' for personalization, which is not a training-exclusion control. Community privacy complaints concern server syncing and vendor sharing, not training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
